en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance style building on a corner square. The façade has multiple floors, arched entrances, statues, a central clock, and elaborate roofline towers and dormers. In front there are people walking and horse‑drawn carriages on the street. Printed captions in German at the top identify the location as Karlsbad and the building as the K. K. Hauptpost (Imperial and Royal Main Post Office). A small printer's mark is along the right edge.
